classification.Preserved: All required public-language and approved carrier observations for the case are established with an attributable witness.
classification.Violated: At least one required observation differs or an invalid construction is accepted, with a witness naming the observable and actual result.
classification.Unknown: Identity, execution, parsing, extraction, dependency, opacity or budget prevents a sound decision. Unknown is fail-closed and cannot satisfy a mandatory case or reject a mutation.

observables.O-BINDING: math.cases is a callable function in the closed math module and produces canonical MathCases identity rather than generic content or a pre-resolved grid.
observables.O-SIGNATURE: The qualified function accepts zero or more positional values castable to Content as children and only delim, reverse and gap as named. Named arguments may precede children. Unknown, duplicate, children: and non-content positional arguments are rejected; no argument is truncated or ignored.
observables.O-DELIMITER-NORMALIZATION: delim accepts none, one valid delimiter supplied as a one-codepoint string or symbol, or an array of exactly two optional valid delimiters. A single delimiter infers its matching pair; none becomes (none, none); an array preserves each optional side and order. Invalid type, cardinality, codepoint count or math delimiter class is rejected.
observables.O-EXPLICITNESS: The carrier has independent delim, reverse and gap presence bits. Omission leaves each bit false; every supplied named sets only its own bit, including delim equal to braces, reverse false and gap 0.2em. Effective values do not determine presence.
observables.O-SET-PRECEDENCE: Without mutating the stored carrier, layout derives effective delim, reverse and gap independently as element-explicit, then cascaded math.cases property, then ("{", "}"), false and 0.2em. Set rules use the same casts, reject unknown and invalid values, and never set element presence bits, rewrite stored defaults or leak cascaded fields into repr.
observables.O-ROUTE-CONVERGENCE: Qualified math.cases and bare cases construct the same complete MathCases carrier and public result for equivalent children and named arguments. Neither route pre-resolves children into rows or handles errors more permissively.
observables.O-EVALUATION-ONCE: Each syntactic child and named-value occurrence is evaluated exactly once in source order before the common constructor consumes it; errors and spreads are propagated rather than retried, discarded or converted to Empty.
observables.O-CARRIER: MathCases stores ordered children, a pair of optional delimiter chars, reverse, relative gap and MathCasesExplicit { delim, reverse, gap }. Omitted fields store constructor defaults, explicit arguments store their supplied normalized values, and cascade is never baked into this carrier. Equality and hash include every stored value, child order and presence bit.
observables.O-WALKERS: Clone preserves the complete carrier; map_content recurses once through each child in order; terminal map_text preserves the carrier; plain_text joins branch values with comma-space while retaining MathAlignPoint structurally inside each child until the proper consumer.
observables.O-REPR: Canonical repr is cases(delim?, reverse?, gap?, children: tuple), with optional fields in that order only when their presence bits are true. Zero children is (), one child has a tuple comma, many preserve order; optional delimiter sides print none and gap uses relative-length repr. Cascaded values and derived rows never appear.
observables.O-RECONSTRUCTION: apply_math_default, apply_math_style and complete-content reconstruction transform only children where applicable and preserve delimiter sides, reverse, relative gap and all three presence bits exactly. They never materialize rows, delimiter glyphs or cascade-derived explicitness.
observables.O-BRANCH-RESOLUTION: Layout forms exactly one initial branch per stored child, uses denominator style for branch content, and only then splits MathAlignPoint boundaries into aligned cells. Child order and per-branch boundary order are preserved; no child or boundary is flattened early.
observables.O-DIRECTION-DELIMITER: With reverse=false only delim.0 is rendered on the left; with reverse=true only delim.1 is rendered on the right. A None selected side emits no glyph. The chosen valid delimiter stretches to the complete grid and remains baseline-relative without a second axis shift.
observables.O-GAP: The effective Rel<Length> gap resolves against the exterior style and controls vertical branch separation. Default 0.2em, explicit/cascaded 1em and percentage values remain distinguishable; a relative percentage is not reduced prematurely to a fixed Length.
observables.O-LAYOUT-REGRESSION: The P919/P923/P945/P1042/P1132 contracts remain intact: denominator-style level descent, natural ampersand alignment, no redundant delimiter padding, grid centered once on the math axis, and external ascent/descent including the stretched delimiter without top alignment.
observables.O-COMPATIBILITY-WRAPPER: The internal legacy rows wrapper remains non-public and preserves existing row/cell boundaries and geometry at old call sites. It does not broaden the public signature, discard boundaries or make the public carrier row-based.
observables.O-FAIL-CLOSED: Identity mismatch, opaque carrier/cascade/evaluation/delimiter/layout observation, unsupported extractor, unreadable or truncated output, timeout, crash, OOM, swap, missing dependency or exhausted budget is Unknown. The executable certification policy grants Unknown zero acceptance and mutation credit, never increments the score numerator, retains every valid mutation in the denominator and blocks mandatory-case or valid-mutation gates. An explicitly opaque non-mandatory control may match expected Unknown but still earns no credit.

mutation_requirements: drop math.cases registration, register a non-function or return generic/pre-resolved content
reject zero children, lose child order, truncate positionals, accept integers or allow children: named
skip delimiter pair inference, collapse optional sides, accept invalid cardinality/type/class or replace none with a sentinel glyph
collapse independent explicitness bits, infer presence from values or print cascade-derived fields
ignore a set property, accept invalid set values, or let cascade override an explicit field
keep bare cases on legacy validation, pre-resolve rows, ignore errors/spreads or evaluate an occurrence twice
omit a carrier field or bit from equality, hash, walkers or reconstruction
flatten children or split MathAlignPoint before the layout consumer
always use the left/opening delimiter, always use the right/closing delimiter, reverse child order or render None
collapse Rel<Length> to fixed Length, ignore percentage or use the wrong exterior size for gap
regress denominator style, ampersand alignment, delimiter padding, axis centering or external extents
grant success from render bytes or opaque extraction
at the executed certification-policy boundary, grant Unknown acceptance/mutation credit, increment its score numerator, remove a valid Unknown mutation from the denominator or fail to block its gate
